skills.name: 锋略
skills.text: 出牌阶段开始时，你可以拼点：若你赢，被拼点者将其每个区域各一张牌交给你；若你没赢，你交给被拼点者一张牌。拼点结算后你可以令其获得你的拼点牌。
notes: playPhaseStarting optional trigger: selectTarget otherLivingWithHand, startPindian with resultBind (trigger-based pindian, 简庸/伏皇后 precedent).
Win branch: three selectAndMoveOwnedCard ops (hand/equipment/judgment, chooser = the counterpart, destination ownerHand, skipIfNoCards) gated by pindianWon with the contest sourceBind.

Loss branch: one hand card to selectedTargetHand gated by pindianNotWon. Settlement gift: chooseOption give/keep plus the new givePindianCard op, which claims the owner's own pindian card out of the discard pile into the counterpart's hand.

skills.name: 谋识
skills.text: 出牌阶段限一次，你可以交给一名角色一张手牌，然后当其于其下回合出牌阶段对一名角色首次造成伤害后，你摸一张牌。
notes: Gift: playPhaseStarting optional trigger gated by a turn-scoped boolean state ledger and a non-empty hand; selectAndMoveOwnedCard to selectedTargetHand then changeParticipantMarker mouShi +1 (PlayPhaseStarting SelectedTarget path, 陆绩 precedent).
Drain: compulsory afterDamageApplied trigger (subject any) gated by cardActionPhaseIsPlay plus the new eventSourceMarkerCount compare; draws one and consumes the marker via targetRef eventSource.
Expiry: compulsory turnEnding trigger (turnOwnerScope otherLiving) consuming any remaining marker from the turn owner (eventTarget).

observations: OL lists 荀谌 as qun 3HP with quality 稀有; the hero page labels him 通过拼点获得敌人大量的牌.

New shared pieces: trigger value eventSourceMarkerCount (after-damage facts carry the source's markers), attributed marker targetRef eventSource, and the givePindianCard effect (reads the skill's PindianResultDeterminedEvent and moves the owner's pindian card from the discard pile).
Marker whitelists (composition validator, runtime lifecycle gate, eventTarget/eventSource reference lists) gained the TurnEnding window for expiry-style markers.
